global: This is a bowl of miso ramen, its rich, golden broth steaming warmly. Thin noodles, tender chashu pork, and chopped green onions float gently, nestled in a patterned ceramic bowl on a wooden table under soft, ambient light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle reflections from ambient lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red and green geometric patterns and Chinese characters along its rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains thin noodles, green onions, and meat pieces floating in its rich, textured surface.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly textured bowl and slender handle, angled diagonally.
regions.meat: Chashu pork pieces show browned, slightly glistening surfaces with irregular, curled shapes and visible fat marbling.
